name: Norton Neo
businessModel: Free browser funded by Gen Digital's Norton security and VPN business; Gen says premium features may follow but the core experience stays free
paidNote: Core browser free; Gen has said premium features may be added later. One review mentions a limited free VPN quota (unverified).
statusNote: Early access May 2025; free worldwide release Dec 2, 2025; agentic assistant in early access since May 2026

version.current: iOS 1.6.0; desktop build numbers not published by the vendor
version.upstream: Chromium (about 156 per an unverified third-party listing)

updateCadence: Frequent app updates (iOS 1.6.0 on Oct 23, 2026; Google Play update Oct 25, 2026); desktop cadence not published
pitch: Free Chromium AI browser from Norton with a built-in VPN, ad blocker and Magic Box.
summary: Chromium-based AI browser from Gen Digital (Norton) with a Magic Box for search and chat, auto-grouped tabs, built-in ad blocking, VPN and anti-fingerprinting. Free worldwide since Dec 2025 on Windows, macOS, iOS and Android.
bestFor: Norton users who want an AI browser from a security vendor
People who want ad blocking, a VPN and phishing protection without extensions
Chrome users who want AI search and tab grouping with Chrome Web Store extensions
Those who want AI chats stored locally by default
notFor: Anyone who wants a fully open-source or auditable browser
People who want to switch AI off completely
Users who need deep customization or power-user tab tools
Those who want the most capable agentic browsing today

pros.title: Security built in
pros.detail: Norton WebShield blocks phishing and malicious sites, extended to webmail through the Scam Analyzer engine.

pros.title: Blocking on by default
pros.detail: Ad, tracker and cookie-banner blocking plus anti-fingerprinting (added May 2026) work without extensions.

pros.title: Built-in VPN
pros.detail: An adaptive VPN is included in the browser and engages on sensitive sites such as banking.

pros.title: AI chats local by default
pros.detail: Gen says chats are stored on the device and that AI providers are contractually barred from retaining queries or training on them.

pros.title: Magic Box and tab grouping
pros.detail: One box routes input to search, a URL or AI chat, and AI groups related tabs automatically.

pros.title: Chrome Web Store extensions
pros.detail: Reviews report Chromium extension compatibility, and the browser is free worldwide.

cons.title: Closed source
cons.detail: You must trust Gen Digital's implementation and its unaudited privacy claims.

cons.title: AI cannot be fully disabled
cons.detail: A third-party review says memory is configurable but the AI layer has no single off switch.

cons.title: Young product
cons.detail: Reviewers describe an immature feature set and, on Android, slowness and instability in user reviews.

cons.title: Limited customization
cons.detail: Fewer themes, layout options and advanced settings than Vivaldi or Firefox.

cons.title: Parent company history
cons.detail: Gen Digital owns Avast, which the FTC ordered in 2024 to pay $16.5M for selling browsing data.

faq.a: Yes, it has been free worldwide with no waitlist since Dec 2, 2025. Gen has said premium features may be added later while the core stays free.

faq.q: Is Norton Neo based on Chromium?
faq.a: Reviews and a third-party listing say it is Chromium-based; Gen's own pages do not name the engine. Chrome Web Store extensions are reported to work.

faq.q: Does Neo have an AI agent?
faq.a: Early reviews found no agentic features, but Gen's May 2026 update added early access to an agentic assistant, and it describes browser-layer defences against indirect prompt injection.
